Definition: a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin)
BiblicalUsage: 1) round; 1a) a round district (environs of the Jordan valley); 1b) a round loaf (of bread); 1c) a round weight, talent (of gold, silver, bronze, iron)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
